target_false_positive_policy: Match globally in confidence order against all visible native GT at IoU>=0.5 first. Ignore predictions matched to other plants even if class is wrong. For unmatched predictions count target FP only when predicted mask centroid falls within the private bounding rectangle enclosing all visible calyx bboxes of current target per frozen trajectory. If the target is not visible, target FP is zero; all-object metrics remain reported.
target_matching_order: Global class-agnostic one-to-one matching before selecting current target per frozen trajectory.
target_eligible_policy: Ignore matched instances of current target per frozen trajectory below 100 native visible pixels or 8 pixel minimum bbox side; do not rematch excluded predictions.

target_implementation.target_plant: Per-frame frozen trajectory target_plant; evaluator only
target_implementation.matching: confidence-ordered class-agnostic native mask IoU>=0.5 against ALL visible truth first
target_implementation.neighbor_matches: ignored even with wrong class; never target false positives
target_implementation.duplicate_small_predictions: global one-to-one unmatched duplicates retain centroid FP rule; differs from global eligible any-small-ignore policy
target_implementation.unmatched_false_positive: only if predicted mask centroid lies inside union bounding rectangle of all visible current-target calyx boxes
target_implementation.target_region_source: private evaluator only; never input to inference or tracking
target_implementation.empty_target: no envelope, no target false positives; all metrics still reported

limitations: Routes may have different durations and target coverage; compare inspection and transit separately; partial orbits remain explicit in protocol.
Target envelopes are evaluator truth; no automatic target ROI capability or perfect false-positive attribution is claimed.
Target eligible uses global one-to-one matching: unmatched duplicate-small predictions keep the centroid FP rule, unlike all-object eligible which ignores any small-object IoU>=0.5 match.
Adjacent ID switches conditional on paired spatial matches, not IDF1/HOTA/MOTA.
One common ArUco8, no independent marker acquisition at C07; 3D localization and final PiP remain pending.
Validation plants with shared morphology; no external holdout or production claim.
Eligible100pixels/side8 is an engineering convention, not universal YOLO limit.
